dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you need me to tell her?

dialogues.speaker: Cava
dialogues.text: Hmm... Let me think... No, it's okay. Navia is one of those who "have things to do." If I disturb Navia, Grandpa would lecture me again.

dialogues.speaker: Cava
dialogues.text: But since you're Navia's friend, you're my friend, too! Have this! I won't take no for an answer!
